title: Color Maximite 2 - ARM CPU that runs BASIC!
summary: The 8-Bit Guy reviews the Color Maximite 2, a modern ARM-based computer that boots straight into BASIC. He shows what it can do as a retro-style machine.
why: It is cited as a review of a new boot-to-BASIC computer, and one commenter suggests it for a kid starting to program.

quote.text: I highly recommend one for a kid that is starting to dabble with programming.
